'''Star Legends - Galactic Wars''' is a roleplaying game set in the Star Wars ''Legends'' universe, played with a d100 system adapted from ''Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay'' 4th edition. Everything a player or GM needs is on the cards below; the Legends background articles (harvested from Wookieepedia, CC BY-SA 3.0) sit behind them and every game page links to its source.

== How this wiki is organised ==
* Pages starting with <code>SL100:</code> are our own game material; pages ending in <code>/Legends</code> are the Wookieepedia (Legends) reference.
* Red cards are pages still to be written; press ''Edit'' on any page to work on it. [[SL100:Example Weapon]] shows the layout for a statistics page.
